Options.Env.StrictCompute.Desc:
Stop on shader rejection checks for compute and draws (default).
Turn off to skip affected work. Missing images, errors, or stalls can occur. Restart the game after a change.
Options.Env.PerformanceProfile.Desc:
Log performance timings and FPS from the next game launch.
This can reduce performance.
Options.Env.PerformanceFrameTrace.Desc:
Keep the last 4,096 presentation intervals and write them to the log at shutdown.
Requires performance profiling. Close the game normally to save the trace.
Options.OverlayEnabled.Label: Performance display
Options.OverlayEnabled.Desc: Show performance statistics. F1 toggles the display for this run. SHARPEMU_OVERLAY=0 starts it hidden.
Options.OverlayMode.Label: Display mode
Options.OverlayMode.Desc: Full shows all counters. Minimal and Title bar show FPS, CPU, GPU usage, and elapsed time. GPU usage is per-process on Windows; otherwise N/A.
Options.OverlayCorner.Label: Screen corner
Options.OverlayCorner.Desc: Select the saved corner. F2 cycles corners for this run only. This does not move title-bar statistics.

Library.Pack.Title: Pack as .zar
Library.Pack.Heading: Packing {0}
Library.Pack.Explanation: This stores the whole game folder in a single compressed .zar file. SharpEmu runs the game straight from it without unpacking, so it usually takes less disk space and plays the same. The game folder is kept; once the archive is written and checked, you can choose to delete it.
Library.Pack.Done: Done. The archive is ready to launch.
Library.Pack.MuteMusic: Mute the title music while packing
Library.Pack.DeleteSourceWarning: The archive was checked and holds every file of the game folder. Deleting the folder cannot be undone, so keep a backup until you know the archive works.
Library.Pack.DoneDeleted: Done. The archive is ready and the game folder was deleted.
Library.Pack.DeleteSkipped: Done. The game folder is kept because the archive could not be confirmed to hold all of it.
Library.Pack.DeleteFailed: The archive is ready, but deleting the game folder failed: {0}

Options.Env.Desc: Switches passed to the emulator as environment variables at launch.
Options.Env.Bthid.Desc:
Report Bluetooth HID as unavailable for titles whose wheel/FFB middleware polls forever.
Leave off normally. Some titles freeze when init fails.
Options.Env.LoopGuard.Desc:
Do not force quit titles that repeat the same call for too long.
Try this when a game exits on its own while loading.
Options.Env.WritableApp0.Desc:
Allow titles to create and write files inside their install folder.
Needed by unpackaged dumps that write their save or config data under /app0.
Options.Env.VkValidation.Desc:
Enable Vulkan validation layers for GPU debugging.
Slow. Requires the Vulkan SDK to be installed.
Options.Env.DumpSpirv.Desc:
Dump AGC shaders and their SPIR-V translations to the shader-dumps folder.
Use when reporting shader or rendering bugs.
Options.Env.SkipRt.Desc:
Skip compute shaders that use ray tracing. Off by default.
This can remove effects or cause incorrect graphics. Restart the game after a change.
Options.Env.LogDirectMemory.Desc:
Log direct memory allocations and failures to the console.
Use when a game aborts or exits during boot.
Options.Env.LogIo.Desc:
Log file open, read, and path-resolve activity to the console.
Use when a game cannot find its data files during boot.
Options.Env.LogNp.Desc: Log NP (PlayStation Network) library calls to the console.
Options.Env.RenderDoc.Desc:
Load the RenderDoc in-application API so frames can be captured from inside the emulator.
Press F12 while the game runs to capture one frame; captures land in user/logs/capture_logs/<TITLE_ID>.
Requires RenderDoc to be installed. Slows the GPU down and hangs some titles, so leave it off unless you are debugging.
Options.Env.DisableVkImplicitLayers.Desc: When RenderDoc is enabled, other conflicting overlays can cause device loss. Enabling this option may fix it.
Options.DefaultProfile.Label: Default profile name
Options.DefaultProfile.Desc: Name used when a game asks for text input. Defaults to Sharp.
Options.Console.Type.Label: Console
Options.Console.Language.Label: Console language
Options.WindowMode.Label: Window mode
Options.WindowMode.Desc: Regular window, desktop borderless, or exclusive fullscreen.
Options.Resolution.Label: Resolution
Options.Resolution.Desc: Initial window size or exclusive fullscreen resolution.
Options.Display.Label: Display
Options.Display.Desc: Monitor used for centering and fullscreen.
Options.RefreshRate.Label: Refresh rate
Options.RefreshRate.Desc: Exclusive fullscreen refresh rate. Automatic selects the closest mode.
Options.Scaling.Label: Scaling
Options.Scaling.Desc: Scale the native guest image without changing its internal resolution.
Options.VSync.Label: VSync
Options.VSync.Desc: Use FIFO presentation for tear-free output.
Options.PortableData.Label: Portable data
Options.PortableData.Desc: Keep settings, saves and caches next to the executable instead of the system profile. Applies after a restart.
Options.Hdr.Label: HDR output
Options.Hdr.Desc: Use HDR when the selected display and graphics backend support it. Auto falls back to SDR.
Options.Env.BinkPlayback.Label: Bink video playback
Options.Env.BinkPlayback.Desc:
Host plays Bink videos through the FFmpeg bridge, but some games may have issues.
Guest uses the game engine's own decoder.
Skip skips Bink videos, which can make development easier.
Options.CpuEngine.Label: CPU engine
Options.CpuEngine.Desc: Execution engine used to run game code.
Options.Strict.Label: Strict dynlib resolution
Options.Strict.Desc: Fail the launch when an imported symbol cannot be resolved.
Options.LogLevel.Label: Log level
Options.LogLevel.Desc: Verbosity of the emulator console output.
Options.TraceImports.Label: Import trace limit
Options.TraceImports.Desc: Trace the first N imports per module (0 = off).
Options.CrashDump.Label: Crash dumps
Options.CrashDump.Desc: Save crash dumps beside the run log (Windows x64 only). Dumps can be large and contain private data.
Options.LogToFile.Label: Log to file
Options.LogToFile.Desc: Mirror emulator output to a log file.
Options.LogFilePath.Label: Log file path
Options.LogFilePath.Default: No custom path — logs go to user/logs next to the emulator.
Options.OverrideLogFile.Label: Override log file
Options.OverrideLogFile.Desc: Use the exact file path instead of appending title ID and timestamp.
Options.TitleMusic.Label: Title music
Options.TitleMusic.Desc: Loop the selected game's preview music in the library.
Options.Discord.Label: Discord presence
Options.Discord.Desc: Show the running game on your Discord profile.
Options.Language.Label: Emulator language
Options.Language.Desc: Language used throughout the launcher. Applies immediately.
